The CEO Building Reliability into A Volatile Semiconductor Market


Image


stephanie.quinn


Thu, 1 Oct 2026 - 11:29


In this


*Chief Executive* interview, Everspin Technologies CEO Sanjeev Aggarwal talks with writer Katie Kuehner-Hebert about what reliability means in a semiconductor market where customers are also looking for long-term supply certainty.


Sanjeev discusses Everspin’s approach to product reliability, manufacturing and customer relationships, including the company’s long history with Toggle MRAM and the importance of supporting systems designed to remain in service for years. The conversation also looks at the decisions semiconductor leaders have to make when customers depend on both consistent performance and continued product availability.
